input.question: How do people pirate movies that are currently in theaters?
input.ground_truth: 1. Really really good camcorders. 2. Some digital channels allow you to stream movies before they are released, just hit record button. 3. Copies of movies are sent to various critics or private screenings. Those can be stolen.
